text:
sara.partnerships: Quick sync — Rapid Shadow Fellowship soft-launch next Tue. Need final SI mentor shadowing roster, instructor kit contents, and cert gating defined by EOD Fri. Who can own end-to-end?

lina.enablement: I can own the instructor kit + train-the-trainer session. Can we reuse the micro-cert rubric from last quarter? See draft here: https://drive.redwood/workbooks/rapid-shadow (will update).

matt.sales: I can surface 3 SI leads who said they'd join the pilot. Need firm dates so I can lock calendars.

dan.platform: FYI some SIs will request on-prem packaging for the kit (air-gapped). @karen.training do we have an offline bundle?

karen.training: Yes — we have an offline zip with slides, labs, and a facilitator checklist. I'll push a TL;DR to the partner repo. Also proposing a proctoring step for the cert (live + recorded).

jenna.ops: Ops note — if partners request hosted sandboxes they must file /forms/partner-sandbox. Capacity is constrained next week for Dedicated pools.

sara.partnerships: Plan: Lina + Karen pair on cert rubric and proctoring. Matt to gather SI contacts & confirm attendance. Jenna to manage sandbox requests. Dan to validate on-prem packaging. I’ll collate answers and send invites. Lina — can you run a 30m train-the-trainer Fri 10am PT?

lina.enablement: Friday 10am PT works. I'll prep a 15-slide deck + two lab exercises. Example quickstart for the lab: ```bash
# start mock inference
curl -X POST https://mock.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

matt.sales: :thumbsup: I'll ping the SI contacts today and confirm 6 mentors.

karen.training: Proctoring plan: live Zoom + recorded submission; pass threshold 80%. Add a remediation lab for those who fail. I can draft the SOP.

jenna.ops: Noted. If anyone requests hosted sandboxes please cc me and include partner name + expected user counts. I'll open capacity ticket CAP-9872.

deploy-bot: Reminder — Dedicated pool autoscale maintenance Sat 02:00 UTC. Sandbox provisioning may be delayed during the window.

dan.platform: On-prem packaging looks fine from a surface scan, will validate packaging and install runbook by Thu.

lina.enablement: I'll upload the deck + labs to the partner repo by Thu EOD.

matt.sales: Contacts and RSVP updates coming by EOD.

karen.training: Proctoring SOP draft out tomorrow morning.

jenna.ops: Linked the partner sandbox form in the playbook doc once it's uploaded.

sara.partnerships: Great — thanks everyone. I'll assemble the playbook draft and loop in legal for the pilot MSA after we confirm attendees.
